name: Irmagene Irma Kulp (Zacher)
notable_stories: A key family historian who preserves the Silver Ink scrapbooks created by Dradie Kulp and John Kulp
She was born on her father Elmer's birthday
Key family historian; preserved Silver Ink scrapbooks; born on her father Elmer Kulp's birthday
milestones: Mother of Kimberly, Kenneth, and Kippy
Born Dec 1941, Elmer and Amy Kulp's ranch, east side of Lynden, Whatcom County, Washington
education: Irma attended school in Lynden from first grade (about 1947) until mid seventh grade in December, when the family moved to Pasco; several cousins were in her first grade class.
career: Irma was a teacher and retired a month after her mother died in May 2007, at age 65.
locations: Elmer and Amy Kulp's ranch, east side of Lynden, Whatcom County, Washington
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Middle name Elizabeth newly confirmed in this source.
Irma is a second cousin of John Adams; her grandmother Mary McPhail Kulp is also grandmother of Beryl, Elaine and their siblings. [Family research emails, email 48]
Attended the 2009 Kulp McPhail Weidkamp Family Reunion, where Arvella Kulp Layson and other cousins toured the old homestead roads. [Family research emails, email 48]
Unconfirmed: John describes Irma as connected to the Kulp and Weidenkamp families, among others. [Family research emails, email 44]
Open question: The Kulp lineage numbering in email 23 skips 8 and uses 9 twice (John Jacob Kulp and Elmer Spencer Kulp). The generation numbers are not reliable. [Family research emails, email 23]
